description: Signs a user up for SOMA's pre-launch waitlist (the Founding Fifty — first tasters get first-batch priority in Bangalore). Only call this with the user's explicit consent; it stores their contact in SOMA's CRM and sends a one-time welcome email. Idempotent: signing up twice never double-sends.

city.description: The user's city, so SOMA knows where to launch next (optional)

email.description: The user's email address (required, with their consent)

name: join_waitlist
title: Join the SOMA Founding Fifty waitlist
